dedupe_keys.name: peak edp distribution of concrete and steel moment resisting frame buildings subjected to seismic motions with uniform intensity measure coverage

description: Peak EDP distribution of concrete and steel moment resisting frame buildings subjected to seismic motions with uniform intensity measure coverage is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Alexandros Taflanidis, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). This dataset provides samples of nonlinear time-history analyses of 10 archetype-building models with random parameters, representing different design configurations, exposed to a set of recorded ground motions. The ground motions are selected to uniformly populate a specified intensity measure (IM) domain. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 2 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-c4ye-8428. Keywords: archetype buildings, inter-story drift, absolute acceleration, seismic motions, moment resisting frame, reduced order models. Published 2026-03-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
